book.botanicalmekanism.intro: Electrically powered bionic flowers and machines for crafting, infusion and mana transfer.$(p)Bionic flowers can stand on blocks or cables. Use this Lexica on a device to read about it.
book.botanicalmekanism.mana_lotus.title: Conduction Lotus
book.botanicalmekanism.mana_lotus.0: The $(item)Conduction Lotus$(0) turns electricity into mana. Connect a power cable and bind it to a nearby mana spreader with the Wand of the Forest.$(p)It produces up to 80 mana per second, using 4,000 FE.
book.botanicalmekanism.mana_lotus.cost: Make this in a Mechanical Apothecary with one bucket of water and 30,000 FE. It takes 10 seconds.
book.botanicalmekanism.bionic_amaranthus: The $(item)Bionic Jaded Amaranthus$(0) grows mystical flowers nearby. Supply electricity and leave some suitable ground for the flowers.
Make this in a Mechanical Apothecary with one bucket of water and 16,000 FE. It takes 8 seconds.
The $(item)Bionic Clayconia$(0) turns nearby sand into clay balls while powered.$(p)A Rannuncarpus can replace the sand, and a Hopperhock can collect the clay.
Make this in a Mechanical Apothecary with one bucket of water and 16,000 FE. It takes 8 seconds.
book.botanicalmekanism.bionic_agricarnat: The $(item)Bionic Agricarnation$(0) uses electricity to encourage plant growth. Place it beside a farm and supply power to help crops mature faster.
Make this in a Mechanical Apothecary with one bucket of water and 16,000 FE. It takes 8 seconds.
book.botanicalmekanism.bionic_hopperhock: The $(item)Bionic Hopperhock$(0) uses electricity to collect nearby drops into adjacent chests.$(p)Item frames on the chests filter their contents. Sneak-use the Wand on the flower to change the filtering mode.
Make this in a Mechanical Apothecary with one bucket of water and 16,000 FE. It takes 8 seconds.
book.botanicalmekanism.bionic_rannuncarp: The $(item)Bionic Rannuncarpus$(0) uses electricity to pick up and place dropped blocks.$(p)The block two below the flower determines the ground it builds on. Sneak-use the Wand to toggle block-state matching.
Make this in a Mechanical Apothecary with one bucket of water and 16,000 FE. It takes 8 seconds.
book.botanicalmekanism.bionic_exoflame.0: The $(item)Bionic Exoflame$(0) heats nearby furnaces with electricity, replacing fuel and speeding up smelting. Put smeltable ingredients in the furnaces first.
book.botanicalmekanism.bionic_exoflame.c: Make this in a Mechanical Apothecary with one bucket of water and 16,000 FE. It takes 8 seconds.
book.botanicalmekanism.mechanical_apothe: The $(item)Mechanical Apothecary$(0) combines petals, seeds and other ingredients into magical and bionic flowers. Put ingredients on the left and the reagent in the small lower slot.$(p)Each craft needs one bucket of water and electricity.
Fill it with water buckets or fluid pipes. Empty buckets move to the adjacent slot.$(p)Feed reagents through the back and take products from the right. Bionic flowers must be made here.
While a machine is open, use the JEI recipe plus button to fill its ingredients. Hold Shift to fill more.
book.botanicalmekanism.mana_bridge.title: Mana Bridge
book.botanicalmekanism.mana_bridge.0: The $(item)Mana Bridge$(0) moves mana between a pool and pressurized tubes. Place it beside a pool, open Connection Settings on the left to select its side, then choose draw or supply.$(p)It needs electricity and transfers up to 20,000 mana per second. The pool face cannot also connect to a tube.
book.botanicalmekanism.mana_bridge.1: Switch the Wand to Bind mode, sneak-use it on a spreader, then on the machine. The face hit by its bursts must allow Mana input.
book.botanicalmekanism.mana_bridge.2: An Everlasting Mana Pool supplies mana without running out. The machine still transfers up to 20,000 mana per second.
book.botanicalmekanism.mana_bridge.appbo: With Applied Botanics, place the bridge beside a Fluix Mana Pool. Connect the pool to a powered ME network with a channel and a mana cell. All five existing cell tiers work; no separate set is needed.
book.botanicalmekanism.mana_charger.0: Insert one mana tablet, ring or other mana item. Choose charge or drain and set a target percentage. The item moves to the output when it reaches the target.
book.botanicalmekanism.mana_charger.1: Right-click the stand with a spark, then attach a matching spark to a nearby mana pool. Pipes and ME export buses can also supply mana. Use the Mana tab in side configuration to set input and output faces.
book.botanicalmekanism.mana_charger.2: Switch the Wand to Bind mode, sneak-use it on a spreader, then on the machine. The face hit by its bursts must allow Mana input.
book.botanicalmekanism.mana_charger.3: A pool touching a Mana input face can supply this machine directly. All faces share a limit of 20,000 mana per second. Transfer stops when full.
book.botanicalmekanism.mana_charger.4: To charge items, set the face touching a pool to Mana input. Drained item mana stays in the stand; enable an output face and auto-eject to return it to an adjacent pool. No separate pool direction is needed.
book.botanicalmekanism.mana_infuser.0: The $(item)Mana Infusion Chamber$(0) uses electricity and mana to make manasteel, mana pearls and other infused materials.$(p)An Alchemy Catalyst or Conjuration Catalyst in the extra slot enables its corresponding recipes.
book.botanicalmekanism.mana_infuser.1: The eight input slots infuse up to eight items per second, including mixed materials. Each item uses its recipe mana cost. Work waits for enough mana, and speed upgrades make it faster.
book.botanicalmekanism.mana_infuser.2: Place an Alchemy or Conjuration Catalyst directly beneath the chamber, or put one in its catalyst slot. The slot takes priority. The basin shows the active catalyst symbol.
book.botanicalmekanism.mana_infuser.3: Switch the Wand to Bind mode, sneak-use it on a spreader, then on the machine. The face hit by its bursts must allow Mana input.
book.botanicalmekanism.mana_infuser.4: A pool touching a Mana input face can supply this machine directly. All faces share a limit of 20,000 mana per second. Transfer stops when full.
book.botanicalmekanism.runic_forge.title: Runic Forge
book.botanicalmekanism.runic_forge.0: The $(item)Runic Forge$(0) automates rune crafting using electricity and mana. Put ingredients on the left and livingrock or another reagent in its own slot.$(p)Runes used as catalysts stay in the ingredient slots for the next craft.
book.botanicalmekanism.runic_forge.1: Switch the Wand to Bind mode, sneak-use it on a spreader, then on the machine. The face hit by its bursts must allow Mana input.
book.botanicalmekanism.runic_forge.2: A pool touching a Mana input face can supply this machine directly. All faces share a limit of 20,000 mana per second. Transfer stops when full.
book.botanicalmekanism.pure_converter.0: Supply power and insert logs, stone or other supported materials to make livingwood, livingrock and similar products. Use a Pure Daisy for water and conversions that need special surroundings.
book.botanicalmekanism.pure_converter.1: Mix logs, stone and other materials in the eight input slots. Each cycle converts up to eight items; smaller batches also work. Livingwood and livingrock take about 60 seconds before speed upgrades. Leave room for the whole batch.
book.botanicalmekanism.terra_condenser.0: Build a 3x3 platform with livingrock at the center and corners and lapis blocks at the remaining positions. Place the machine above the center, add ingredients and supply mana to make terrasteel.
book.botanicalmekanism.terra_condenser.1: Switch the Wand to Bind mode, sneak-use it on a spreader, then on the machine. The face hit by its bursts must allow Mana input.
book.botanicalmekanism.terra_condenser.2: A pool touching a Mana input face can supply this machine directly. All faces share a limit of 20,000 mana per second. Transfer stops when full.
book.botanicalmekanism.botanical_brewery: The $(item)Botanical Brewery$(0) brews with electricity and mana. Put ingredients on the left and a Managlass Vial or Alfglass Flask in the extra slot.$(p)The vessel determines how many doses it holds.
Switch the Wand to Bind mode, sneak-use it on a spreader, then on the machine. The face hit by its bursts must allow Mana input.
A pool touching a Mana input face can supply this machine directly. All faces share a limit of 20,000 mana per second. Transfer stops when full.
book.botanicalmekanism.ore_processor.0: The $(item)Ore Processing Chamber$(0) uses mana and electricity to turn stone into ore. Place an Orechid in its extra slot.$(p)With an Orechid Ignem, process netherrack in a ceiling dimension such as the Nether. The resulting ore is random.
book.botanicalmekanism.ore_processor.1: Eight input slots buffer incoming materials. The machine chooses one matching item for each operation.
book.botanicalmekanism.ore_processor.2: Switch the Wand to Bind mode, sneak-use it on a spreader, then on the machine. The face hit by its bursts must allow Mana input.
book.botanicalmekanism.ore_processor.3: A pool touching a Mana input face can supply this machine directly. All faces share a limit of 20,000 mana per second. Transfer stops when full.
book.botanicalmekanism.metamorphic_stone: The $(item)Metamorphic Chamber$(0) turns stone into metamorphic stone using electricity and mana.$(p)The biome affects which varieties are more common; the result cannot be selected directly.
Eight input slots buffer incoming materials. The machine chooses one matching item for each operation.
Switch the Wand to Bind mode, sneak-use it on a spreader, then on the machine. The face hit by its bursts must allow Mana input.
A pool touching a Mana input face can supply this machine directly. All faces share a limit of 20,000 mana per second. Transfer stops when full.
book.botanicalmekanism.elven_trade_contr: The $(item)Elven Trade Controller$(0) sends ingredients through an Alfheim Portal and collects what the elves return. Place it beside the portal core, select that side and supply electricity.
The portal still needs its frame, Natura Pylons and mana pools. Open it with the Wand before trading.$(p)To upgrade a Lexica, throw it directly into the portal.
To choose an adjacent target, open Connection Settings on the left and click its side. The selection remains active after closing the window.
book.botanicalmekanism.mana_enchanter_co: The $(item)Mana Enchanter Controller$(0) enchants equipment. Place it beside a completed Mana Enchanter, select that side and supply equipment and enchanted books.$(p)It needs electricity and mana. The books are reusable.
Supply the enchanter with a spark or through the controller. If the controller is removed during enchanting, the equipment remains on the enchanter and can be retrieved there.
Switch the Wand to Bind mode, sneak-use it on a spreader, then on the machine. The face hit by its bursts must allow Mana input.
A pool touching a Mana input face can supply this machine directly. All faces share a limit of 20,000 mana per second. Transfer stops when full.
To choose an adjacent target, open Connection Settings on the left and click its side. The selection remains active after closing the window.
book.botanicalmekanism.resonance_spark_a: Right-click a mana-storing machine, such as a Charger or Infuser, with a spark. A matching spark on a nearby pool supplies it. If mana is not arriving, open side configuration and set the top Mana face to input.
Fit a Resonance Augment to the supplying spark and the receiving spark to extend their range to 32 blocks. Use dyes to group sparks. Sneak-use the Wand to remove an augment.
book.botanicalmekanism.corporea_orchid.0: Connect the flower to a powered ME cable. It uses one channel and 4 AE per tick. Attach ordinary Corporea sparks to the flower and chests, then add a separate master spark.
book.botanicalmekanism.corporea_orchid.1: The ME terminal can access these chests, and Corporea funnels can request items from ME. Right-click the flower with an empty hand to check its connection and choose which direction to allow.
book.botanicalmekanism.corporea_orchid.2: Use one Orchid per Corporea network and one spark per double chest. Do not also connect those chests to the same ME network through a storage bus.
book.botanicalmekanism.corporea_orchid.3: The Orchid moves up to 2,048 items per tick. It stops without power, a channel or a master spark; the screen shows the reason. For mana pools, use ME import/export buses and a Mana Storage Cell.
book.botanicalmekanism.corporea_orchid.4: Click a filter slot with a held item, or Shift-click an inventory item to copy it. There are 63 slots. Right-click to clear a sample; use the left toolbar to change filtering.$(p)You can choose whether names and enchantments should count as different items.
book.botanicalmekanism.corporea_orchid.5: With autocrafting enabled, the Orchid asks ME to make items missing from a funnel request. The network needs a matching pattern, ingredients and a crafting CPU.$(p)It keeps up to four jobs, with at most 4,096 items per job.
book.botanicalmekanism.corporea_orchid.6: Once crafting finishes, request the items again. A Corporea Interceptor and Retainer can remember the missing amount and repeat the request when given a redstone signal.
book.botanicalmekanism.corporea_orchid.c: Make this in a Mechanical Apothecary with one bucket of water and 36,000 FE. It takes 12 seconds.
The $(item)Resonance Flower$(0) links nearby Resonance Buds into a mana network. Right-click with an empty hand to set its name and members.$(p)It can also be recycled into a Resonance Augment in a crafting grid.
book.botanicalmekanism.resonance_bud.0: The $(item)Resonance Bud$(0) transfers mana through a Resonance Flower. Place it beside a pool, then right-click to select a network and direction.$(p)Relay mode extends the network range.
book.botanicalmekanism.mana_storage_cell: Mana cells come in 1k, 4k, 16k, 64k and 256k sizes. Put one in an ME Drive or Chest to store mana. A 1k cell holds 8,192,000 mana; each larger tier holds four times as much.
Place an ME Import Bus against a mana pool to fill the cell. Attach an Export Bus to a machine and right-click its filter with a Mana Cell to select mana. Set that machine face to Mana input.
A Storage Bus lets the terminal use mana directly from a pool or machine. Use a held Mana Cell on the terminal mana entry to transfer mana; Shift-click transfers more.
Idle power is 0.5, 1, 1.5, 2 and 2.5 AE/t, respectively. Craft each tier with its matching ME storage component.$(p)Existing mana cells become 1k cells and keep their contents.
A Pattern Provider can send mana and ingredients together. Set the receiving Mana face to Input. Use Item Input/Output to receive reagents and return products through that face.

With AE2 JEI Integration installed, the JEI plus button includes mana for infusion, rune, terra and brewing patterns. You can also search for Mana and drag it into a pattern before adjusting the amount.
Brewing uses the displayed vessel for its mana cost and output. Preload reusable runes and catalysts in the machine; they do not need to be included in the pattern.
With Applied Botanics installed, these cells also supply Fluix Mana Pools. Existing Applied Botanics mana cells work alongside them. The terminal has one mana entry, and old patterns keep working.
book.botanicalmekanism.mana_packet.title: Mana Wisp
book.botanicalmekanism.mana_packet.0: Breaking an ME Interface or similar block that holds mana releases a Mana Wisp. Use it on a mana pool or machine to return the mana, or deposit it through an ME terminal.
Attach a Mechanical Spark to a mana pool or mana-storing machine. Dyes, spark augments, Phantom Ink and the Wand work as usual. Machines need Mana input enabled on top.

Connected mechanical sparks of the same color share their master spark's range and efficiency upgrades. Use one master per group. Empty-hand right-click any connected mechanical spark to open its upgrade slots.
book.botanicalmekanism.master_mechanical: The Master Mechanical Spark holds upgrades for its group. Right-click with an empty hand and insert up to eight range and eight efficiency upgrades. You can also apply an upgrade directly to any connected mechanical spark.

The master also accepts ordinary spark augments. Pool-to-pool transfer still needs the usual Dominant, Recessive or other appropriate augment.$(p)Multiple masters in one group disable shared upgrades. Remove the extra master to restore them.

Sneak-use the Wand to remove the native augment first, then the spark. Range and efficiency upgrades stay inside the master item.$(p)Connections require loaded chunks in the same dimension. Shared upgrades stop when the master unloads or is removed.
book.botanicalmekanism.spark_range_upgra: Each upgrade in a master adds eight blocks of range, up to eight upgrades. Range starts at 12 blocks and reaches 76, measured separately along each axis.$(p)The bonus connects mechanical sparks in the same group. Ordinary sparks keep their usual range.
book.botanicalmekanism.spark_efficiency_: Install in a master to increase its group's transfer speed. Each adds one base rate, up to eight upgrades for nine times the original speed. Mana cost is unchanged.
